about_the_game:
Grow. Harvest. Survive the Crash.

Farmers Market is a strategic farming sim and market simulator where crops behave like stocks — and prices never stay stable. Plant vegetables and fruits on unlocked, purchased plots, buy and sell based on shifting market conditions, and protect your profits from bugs, crows, and weeds.

It’s cozy… until it isn’t. The market can crash at any time — and your next harvest might not even cover what you just spent on tools to grow it. Meet tough financial goals under pressure, or risk falling behind in this blend of economic sim, business sim, and resource management challenge.

🧠 Strategic Farming Meets a Dynamic Economy

Every decision matters. Do you buy early and flood your plots with carrots? Wait for prices to spike? Harvest everything before the economy takes a dive?

With limited space and shifting prices, Farmers Market rewards careful planning, good timing, and long-term thinking.

🌿 Key Features

🌱 Grow and manage crops across all of your available plots

💹 Buy, sell, and trade crops based on a dynamic, real-time economy

🐛 Defend your farm from bugs, crows, and invasive weeds

🧠 Time your buying, selling, and harvests to maximize profits

💰 Hit financial targets to unlock tools, expand plots, and earn farm upgrades

🎲 Adapt to random economic events that affect crop prices

🔧 Upgrade your tools to automate production and gain a market advantage

📉 Survive market crashes with smart strategies and backup plans

👀 Watch the economy shift — sometimes in your favor… sometimes not

Will you outsmart the market — or get left behind?
📬 Add to your Wishlist and be ready when the market surges — or crashes.

📌 Notes from the Developer

  • Solo-developed by Aimee Harper

  • Demo available during Steam Next Fest (October 2025)

  • Full release planned soon after

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+ or Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 3000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Mouse, keyboard
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Dual Core or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce 600 series or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster load times
